_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, so a later edit to scene.narration can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Spellbook is that list. Sixteen shelves, seven hundred and ninety-seven tools, and it runs offline.

first-run.text: Open it and it's already full. No account, no setup, nothing to configure.

browse-shelf.text: Sixteen shelves, sorted by the job you are doing, not by who is selling it.

shelf-breadth.text: Past the AI tooling it keeps going. Self-hosting, home servers, hardware you own.

card-open.text: The back is a markdown file that ships inside the app.

card-depth.text: Every tool gets a row: what it does, what it runs on, and a link straight to it.

card-second-category.text: The MCP catalog reads the same way. Every connector named, described, and linked.

search-hits.text: Search runs locally over every card. Matching lines come back highlighted, in context.

search-empty.text: When nothing matches it says so, offers a spelling, and shows you all sixteen shelves.

recap.text: It's a static build. The catalog ships inside it, and nothing you type leaves the machine.

close.text: Spellbook, from Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.

no-directory.text: Cloud AI has one address. Local AI is a thousand repositories, and nobody hands you the list.

where-people-quit.text: So you try the one you heard of, hit a dead README, and stop looking.
